name: MEL01A (North)

address.note: STACK MEL01 page gives only 'Truganina'; 399 Palmers Rd per ITK Research (source 10) and OSM building tags (source 9); datacenterHawk listing (source 2) not fetchable (403). Tech Business News groundbreaking article (10 Dec 2021) lists 'Property Details Address 148-248 Leakes Road TRUGANINA' (lots L1 LP97487, LA PS812888, LS2 PS812889) - differs from 399 Palmers Rd (OSM-tagged MEL01A building, ITK, Baxtel); by OSM address numbering 148-248 Leakes Rd is the north side of Leakes Rd east of Palmers Rd, ~2km south of MEL01. Unresolved

lat.note: geocoded: centroid of OSM building "Stack Infrastructure MEL01A", 399 Palmers Rd

builder.note: Hickory Aug 2023 release: 'Hickory commenced construction on stage one of the 72MW campus in 2021 and achieved an Occupancy Permit in August 2023'. A.G. Coombs was mechanical/building-services subcontractor for Stages 1 and 2 (source 12); Beon Energy delivered the campus substation EPC (source 13)

developer.note: Hickory Data Centres (division of Hickory) acquired site early 2021 and broke ground Dec 2021 (sources 6,11); STACK took over Hickory's data centre projects in June 2022 ('STACK Australia is currently constructing a 72MW campus... two 36MW buildings', source 11) and operates it. Hickory project page lists it under 'Development' with STACK

mw_it.note: STACK MEL01 page: MEL01A 36MW, North building, 9 data halls across 3 floors; confirmed by Hickory project page (source 3)

mw_grid.note: STACK MEL01 page (fetched): campus 'dedicated onsite 66kV/11kV substation with 135MW total capacity'; Hickory Aug 2023 release says '105MW dedicated onsite substation' - campus-level, not recorded for building

cost_aud_m.note: Build Australia (15 Dec 2021, fetched): 'Upon full completion of each facility, it will constitute a $1.1 billion investment into the Australian market' (each facility = the 72MW Truganina campus and the Canberra site); campus-level (MEL01A+B) and not a building cost, so not recorded. Tech Capital headline frames it as a '$1.1bn data centre construction roadmap' (not fetchable, 403)

authority.note: planning permit for the data centre not found. Site is in Wyndham City Council; PlanningAlerts shows Wyndham application WYP12005/20 at 399 Palmers Rd (received ~19 Dec 2019) for a warehouse with ancillary office (pre-Hickory). The Wyndham refs WYP14790/24 and WYP14905/24 cited by ITK relate to CDC Laverton, not STACK

construction_start.note: Build Australia (published 15 Dec 2021) and Tech Business News (10 Dec 2021) report Hickory Data Centres breaking ground on the Truganina site; Hickory release (source 4): construction commenced 2021

construction_end.note: Hickory release (22 Aug 2023): 'achieved an Occupancy Permit in August 2023'; ribbon-cutting held. Original target was 'availability from Q4 2022' (source 6) / 'early in 2023' (source 11)

open_questions: planning permit for MEL01A/B (authority, reference, dates) not found - Wyndham council register not searchable; possibly issued as part of a campus permit
groundbreaking article gives property as 148-248 Leakes Road (see address note) - unexplained discrepancy with 399 Palmers Rd
the 2021 Wyndham committee site (NW corner Infinity Dr/Palmers Rd, ~365m N of Leakes Rd) is ~1.6km south of the OSM MEL01 buildings, so it is not this site
